content.short: Blockliquidity is an analytics platform covering Hyperliquid traders, whales, markets and vaults.
content.description: Blockliquidity positions itself as an intelligence layer for Hyperliquid, indexing behaviour at the level of individual traders and vaults rather than only aggregate market statistics. Because Hyperliquid runs a transparent on-chain order book, positioning that would be private on a centralised venue is visible here, and a category of analytics products has grown up around that fact. Hyperliquid's own documentation lists it under perps and order book analytics.
